storage.details: On-module eMMC plus M.2 Key M NVMe (PCIe Gen4) on the developer kit carrier.

power.connector: DC barrel jack (9-20V; ships with a 65W adapter)

firmwareCompatibility.notes: JetPack version dictates the supported CUDA/TensorRT stack and kernel.

_notes: aiTops=275 is NVIDIA's stated dense INT8 figure for the 64GB SKU; the 32GB SKU is rated up to 200 TOPS. memoryMb uses 32GB as the representative value; 64GB variant also sold. typicalDrawW=30 is an approximation within the documented 15W-60W configurable power-mode range; exact draw is mode- and workload-dependent. USB port counts reflect the NVIDIA developer-kit carrier board.
